premise: Beaver's gnawing sends chips flying over Hedgehog, who curls up in a huff; but Bird needs twigs for his nest, Beaver's just-right gnawing makes the perfect ones, and the chips make Hedgehog a soft bed.
inspiration: The Belly and the Members (Aesop), turned: the noisy work everyone grumbles about is what everyone needs — with a Goldilocks "just right" running through it.
lesson: The thing that bothers you may be the thing that helps.
learning: A beaver's front teeth never stop growing, so it gnaws wood to keep them short.

en-US.title: Beaver Gnaws Just Right
en-US.text: Chomp, chomp, CHOMP! {beaver:enter} Beaver was at it again. {beaver:live} He gnawed his stick {sfx:chomp} and chips flew everywhere… right onto {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog, who was trying to nap. {hedgehog:face sad} Hmph! {hedgehog:live hold} He curled up in a prickly huff. [curious] Why do you ALWAYS gnaw? {beaver:face surprised} {beaver:wobble} Because my teeth never stop growing, said Beaver. If I didn't gnaw, they'd grow down to my toes! Just then {bird:enter} {bird:go to beaver} Bird fluttered down. {bird:face sad} [sad] I need twigs for my nest, but mine are all too long. {beaver:face happy} [excited] Leave it to me! {beaver:live} {sfx:chomp} Chomp, chomp, chomp: twigs, just right. {bird:face happy} {bird:hop x2} Perfect! {bird:go to branches} Up flew Bird with his twigs, high into the branches, and {bird:live} {sfx:birdsong} sang his thanks. Down below, {hedgehog:live resume} Hedgehog peeked out. All round him lay Beaver's chips, soft and curly. {hedgehog:face happy} Hmm, he said. Just right. Chomp, chomp? asked Beaver. [softly] Chomp away, said Hedgehog. {hedgehog:face sleeping} And he snuggled down for the softest nap of all.

es-ES.title: Castor roe a la medida
es-ES.text: ¡Ñac, ñac, ÑAC! {beaver:enter} Castor ya estaba otra vez. {beaver:live} Royó su palo {sfx:chomp} y las virutas volaron por todas partes… justo encima de {hedgehog:enter} Erizo, que intentaba dormir la siesta. {hedgehog:face sad} ¡Jum! {hedgehog:live hold} Se hizo una bola, muy enfurruñado. [curious] ¿Por qué SIEMPRE estás royendo? {beaver:face surprised} {beaver:wobble} Porque mis dientes no paran de crecer, dijo Castor. ¡Si no royera, me llegarían hasta los pies! En eso, {bird:enter} {bird:go to beaver} Pájaro bajó revoloteando. {bird:face sad} [sad] Necesito ramitas para mi nido, pero las mías son muy largas. {beaver:face happy} [excited] ¡Déjamelo a mí! {beaver:live} {sfx:chomp} Ñac, ñac, ñac: ramitas a la medida. {bird:face happy} {bird:hop x2} ¡Perfectas! {bird:go to branches} Pájaro subió volando a las ramas y {bird:live} {sfx:birdsong} cantó para darle las gracias. Allí abajo, {hedgehog:live resume} Erizo asomó el hocico. A su alrededor había un montón de virutas, blanditas y rizadas. {hedgehog:face happy} Mmm, dijo. Justo a la medida. ¿Ñac, ñac? preguntó Castor. [softly] Ñac, ñac todo lo que quieras, dijo Erizo. {hedgehog:face sleeping} Y se acurrucó para la siesta más blandita del mundo.
